title: Electronic crystals and quasicrystals in semiconductor quantum wells: an AI-powered discovery
title_zh: 半导体量子阱中的电子晶体和准晶体：人工智能驱动的发现
summary: 均质电子气是量子凝聚态物理学的基石，为发展密度泛函理论和理解半导体中的电子相奠定了基础。然而，对现实半导体系统中强相关电子的理论理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于神经网络的变分方法来研究各种电子密度和阱厚度的三维几何中的量子阱。从第一原理开始，我们的无偏人工智能驱动方法揭示了具有单层和双层电荷分布的金属相和结晶相。在出现的双层中，我们发现了一种新的物质量子相：电子准晶体。
abstract: arXiv:2512.10909v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The homogeneous electron gas is a cornerstone of quantum condensed matter physics, providing the foundation for developing density functional theory and understanding electronic phases in semiconductors. However, theoretical understanding of strongly-correlated electrons in realistic semiconductor systems remains limited. In this work, we develop a neural network based variational approach to study quantum wells in three dimensional geometry for a variety of electron densities and well thicknesses. Starting from first principles, our unbiased AI-powered method reveals metallic and crystalline phases with both monolayer and bilayer charge distributions. In the emergent bilayer, we discover a new quantum phase of matter: the electronic quasicrystal.

title: Machine Learning for High-Entropy Catalysts: Methods and Applications
title_zh: 高熵催化剂的机器学习：方法与应用
summary: 高熵合金（HEA）由于其高构型熵、协同元素效应、可调电子结构和优异的结构稳定性，在各种反应中表现出优异的催化性能。然而，HEA 催化剂的巨大组成空间使得传统的实验和理论设计成本高昂且效率低下。近年来，数据驱动的机器学习 (ML) 方法已成为研究催化中 HEA 的强大工具。通过预测模型和机器学习代理，研究人员可以破译这些材料复杂的成分-结构-性能关系。
abstract: arXiv:2609.19837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit exceptional catalytic performance in various reactions due to their high configurational entropy, synergistic elemental effects, tunable electronic structures, and excellent structural stability. However, the vast compositional space of HEA catalysts makes traditional experimental and theoretical design costly and inefficient. In recent years, data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have emerged as powerful tools for studying HEAs in catalysis. Through predictive models and ML surrogates, researchers can decipher the intricate composition-structure-performance relationships of these materials. In addition, by leveraging large language models (LLMs) for knowledge extraction, hypothesis generation and validation, and as a foundation to build integrated design workflows, ML approaches can significantly accelerate the design of novel HEA catalysts. This review systematically summarizes the latest methodological advances and applications of ML methods for HEAs in catalysis, discusses the challenges, and offers insights into future research directions to support the rational design and efficient development of catalysts.

title: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
title_zh: SU(2)-分子磁学的等变旋量消息传递
summary: 预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.

title: A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
title_zh: 神经网络损失景观中关键轨道的通用拓扑对称指数
summary: 由于其高维性，对神经网络损失景观的全局结构的系统理解仍然具有挑战性。网络架构和学习目标产生的对称性提供了一种研究该结构各个方面的方法。尽管越来越多的研究引起了人们对这些对称性的关注，但对它们以及它们产生的临界轨道的系统表征仍然不完整。为了解决这一差距，在这项工作中，我们基于等变度理论家族的方法建立了拓扑对称指数来解码这些对称性。该框架适用于任意网络架构，并包括适用于简并临界轨道的方法。该指数检测临界点的各向同性并量化相应的净拓扑贡献。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbits. The index detects the isotropy of the critical points and quantifies the corresponding net topological contributions. Several examples, including softplus MLPs, Transformers, and equivariant neural networks, are presented to illustrate the computations.

title: SoLiD26: A First Principles Solid-Liquid Interface Dataset for Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: SoLiD26：用于机器学习原子间势的第一原理固液界面数据集
summary: 与传统的从头计算方法相比，机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 能够在更长的时间尺度上模拟更大的原子系统，但需要大量、多样化的训练数据。现有数据集缺乏对固液界面的全面采样，这些界面表现出复杂的现象，例如对于能源和催化材料至关重要的溶剂分层和表面重建。在这里，我们展示了 SoLiD26，这是一个精心策划的固液界面数据集，包含 1540 万个第一性原理结构，最多包含 576 个原子和 15 种化学元素，用于训练和评估 MLIP。
abstract: arXiv:2609.28013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable simulations of larger atomistic systems over longer timescales than traditional ab initio methods but require large, diverse training data. Existing datasets lack comprehensive sampling of solid-liquid interfaces, which exhibit complex phenomena such as solvent layering and surface reconstruction critical for energy and catalytic materials. Here, we present SoLiD26, a curated solid-liquid interface dataset of 15.4 million first-principles structures with up to 576 atoms and 15 chemical elements for training and evaluating MLIPs. The structures were compiled from density functional theory (DFT) calculations, with most configurations originating from ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. SoLiD26 includes aqueous coinage metal interfaces, electrode-electrolyte systems, and selected bulk reference structures, calculated with VASP using the PBE functional and D3 dispersion corrections. The application of SoLiD26 for training and evaluating MLIPs is demonstrated with a suite of MACE models on a simple training, validation and test split. This dataset provides a valuable resource for advancing MLIP development targeted at modelling solid-liquid interfaces in electrochemical and catalytic systems.

title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
title_zh: 用于多模态 X 射线和中子散射反演的组合神经网络
summary: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.

title: Automated Materials Data and Knowledge Extraction using Machine Learning and Large Language Models
title_zh: 使用机器学习和大型语言模型自动提取材料数据和知识
summary: 在过去的十年中，人们致力于开发机器学习 (ML) 方法，以直接从科学文献中提取材料数据（如果可能）和材料知识。本综述追溯了这些方法的演变，从启发式、基于规则的管道，到自然语言处理 (NLP) 模型和基于转换器的编码器，最后到大型语言模型 (LLM) 和能够跨多种模式（包括文本、表格和图形）提取材料信息的代理系统。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past decade, substantial efforts have been devoted to developing machine learning (ML) methods for extracting materials data and, where possible, materials knowledge directly from the scientific literature. This review traces the evolution of these methods from heuristic, rule-based pipelines through natural language processing (NLP) models and transformer-based encoders to, lastly, large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems capable of extracting materials information across multiple modalities, including text, tables, and figures. Beside construction of large, queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs that support downstream materials discovery, we discuss how these advances have enabled new capabilities, such as, generic question answering across materials science, AI co-scientists and chatbots for research assistance, and closed-loop optimization and discovery when integrated with autonomous laboratories. We critically assess the datasets generated using these approaches, their extraction accuracy and computational costs, and the respective strengths and limitations of different methodologies, and even provide practical guidelines for developing more reliable and scalable materials data extraction pipelines. Finally, we identify key open challenges, including the extraction of full materials structure-property-processing-performance tetrahedron at the sample level, the scarcity of reliable benchmark datasets for systematic evaluation, and the resolution of non-standard materials terminology across different document modalities.

title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
title_zh: 代理人工智能以图案语言进行晶体结构设计
summary: 数据驱动的材料发现插值比推断更可靠，并且很少揭示新的结构类型。我们提出了 MatEvolve，一个代理 AI 框架，它以可解释的主题语言设计晶体，其中每个晶体都被编写为一个 emphmotif 配置文件，描述了组成晶体的重复几何图案（emphmotif）。主题轮廓不仅可以作为材料的描述，而且可以作为材料设计的媒介：代理以规定的理由编辑轮廓，并根据修改后的轮廓构造出晶体；然后通过第一性原理计算来验证最有希望的候选者。
abstract: arXiv:2608.15900v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reveals new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework that designs crystals in an interpretable emphlanguage of motifs, in which each crystal is written as a emphmotif profile that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the emphmotifs---composing the crystal. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile with a stated rationale and constructs a crystal from the modified one; the most promising candidates are then validated by first-principles calculations. MatEvolve is built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning. It is applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent-magnet compounds and finds novel (meta)stable crystals that are both new structural prototypes and magnet compounds; under an equal validation budget, it does so an order of magnitude more often than generative models. Beyond design, analyzing the human-readable profiles of the discovered crystals reveals their structure--property relationships.

title: STAR-XPC: Set Transformer for Estimating X-ray Transmission in Polymer Composites
title_zh: STAR-XPC：用于估计聚合物复合材料中 X 射线透射的设置变压器
summary: 评估 X 射线束穿过聚合物复合材料的能量透射比是辐射屏蔽研究中的一项具有挑战性的任务。蒙特卡罗输运模拟的参考解决方案非常准确，但计算成本昂贵：我们的每个参考模拟的上限为 4×10⁹ 光子历史和 20,000 秒（超过 5 小时）的时间限制，而封闭式分析方法无法代表如此复杂的场景。我们提出了一种人工神经网络模型，可在 1-3 毫秒内将无序多组分子成分、它们的质量分数和四个体物理描述符直接映射到传输比 I(t)/I₀。
abstract: arXiv:2610.28709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating the energy transmission ratio of an X-ray beam through a polymer composite is a challenging task in radiation shielding studies. The reference solution with Monte Carlo transport simulation is highly accurate but computationally expensive: each of our reference simulations is capped at 4×10⁹ photon histories and a 20,000 s (over 5 hours) time limit, while closed-form analytical methods fail to represent such complex scenarios. We present an artificial neural network model that maps the unordered multi-set of molecular constituents, their mass fractions, and four bulk physical descriptors directly to the transmission ratio I(t)/I₀ in 1-3 milliseconds. The model is a Set Transformer, which makes it permutation invariant by construction and accepts mixtures of different sizes up to 11 constituents within a fixed-size padded set. Each constituent is embedded with a chemistry-pretrained transformer language model, ChemBERTa. In our proposed method, training data are produced by an automated PENELOPE/penEasy pipeline using the radiation source at 30, 80, 100, and 120 kV tube voltages over polyethylene-based shielding composite slabs of thicknesses spanning 0.15-2.5 mm. After preprocessing, the dataset contains n = 4697 simulated configurations on which a leakage-free, jointly stratified 10-fold cross-validation is performed, attaining mean squared error MSE = (1.12 ± 0.56)×10⁻⁴, normalized-MSE percentage NMSE% = 0.0294% ± 0.0147%, and R² = 0.9988. The corresponding per-sample percentage errors give an alpha-trimmed (α = 0.10) absolute percentage error (APE) of 1.66% and a median APE of 1.15%. Our model's inference is several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying Monte Carlo simulation (sub-millisecond per query vs. several hours for the reference run) with effective accuracy in predicting I(t)/I₀.

title: A machine learning closure for polymer integral equation theory
title_zh: 聚合物积分方程理论的机器学习闭包
summary: 聚合物参考相互作用位点模型（PRISM）理论是 Ornstein-Zernike 液态理论的后代，是预测平衡聚合物体系的结构和热力学的有力工具，但其准确性和适用性在某些重要情况下可能受到限制。通常，这些缺点可以追溯到用于求解积分方程的解析闭包关系。在这里，我们提出了一种基于机器学习（ML）的闭合关系，在均聚物熔体和溶液的粗粒度分子动力学模拟数据集上进行训练。
abstract: Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein–Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus–Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of small-angle neutron scattering experiments. This ML-enhanced PRISM theory can, therefore, enable rapid soft materials discovery and design efforts.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
title_zh: 镁化合物的紧结合与机器学习潜力模型相结合
summary: 我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。
abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.

title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
title_zh: Mamba 量子本征求解器 (MQE)：用于量子化学中可扩展基态模拟的选择性状态空间模型
summary: 使用量子计算方法预测分子电子结构是计算化学中的一个挑战。传统的变分量子本征求解器 (VQE) 通常会受到优化挑战的阻碍。另一种生成量子本征解算器 (GQE) 通过将基态搜索重新表述为离散序列生成来缓解这一问题，但其 Transformer 主干网络面临着二次计算复杂性的问题，成为较大分子的可扩展性的瓶颈。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear O(L) complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism enabling the direct prediction of complete potential energy surfaces (PES). Evaluated on the H₂ molecule, Mamba-QE reproduces Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) reference energies well within chemical accuracy, achieving an energy error below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha across 16 geometries with zero variational violations. Mamba-QE maintains high expressive power while establishing a robust, scalable foundation for quantum simulations of complex molecular systems.

title: macroqc 2.0: An electronic structure theory software for large-scale applications
title_zh: Macroqc 2.0：适合大规模应用的电子结构理论软件
summary: Macroqc 是一款量子化学软件包，专为高精度电子结构计算和大规模分子模拟而设计。 Macroqc 框架为各种多体微扰理论和耦合簇 (CC) 方法提供了能量和解析梯度的高效实现。特别是，二阶 Møller-Plesset 微扰理论 (MP2)、耦合簇单簇和双簇 (CCSD) 以及带有微扰三元组的 CCSD [CCSD(T)] 的解析梯度实现表现出出色的计算性能，即使与已建立的商业量子化学程序相比也是如此。
abstract: macroqc is a quantum chemistry software package designed for high-accuracy electronic structure computations and large-scale molecular simulations. The macroqc framework provides efficient implementations of energies and analytic gradients for a wide range of many-body perturbation theory and coupled-cluster (CC) methods. In particular, the analytic gradient implementations of second-order Møller–Plesset perturbation theory (MP2), coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD), and CCSD with perturbative triples [CCSD(T)] exhibit excellent computational performance, even in comparison with established commercial quantum chemistry programs. In addition to conventional correlated methods, macroqc incorporates several advanced capabilities, including molecular fragmentation techniques for ground and excited state molecular systems and density-fitted analytic gradients. The software also supports interoperability with selected external packages through a flexible plugin framework, allowing developers to construct customized interfaces and extensions. The notable features of macroqc are the linear-scaling systematic molecular fragmentation (LSSMF) and the cluster-in-molecule (CIM) approaches, which enable the application of high-level post-Hartree–Fock approaches to large molecular systems that would otherwise be computationally prohibitive. Furthermore, the new machine learning (ML) library enables the integration of data-driven approaches into quantum chemical workflows, providing efficient tools for developing and applying ML-based models for molecular property prediction and electronic structure computations. With its combination of efficient implementations, advanced theoretical methods, and extensible design, macroqc is expected to serve as a useful platform for a broad range of computational chemistry applications.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Symmetry-Based Parameter Efficient Low-Rank Fine-Tuning for High-Throughput Calculation of Lattice Thermal Conductivity
title_zh: 基于对称性的参数高效低阶微调，用于晶格热导率的高通量计算
summary: 准确有效地预测晶格热导率 (LTC) 对于开发热电、微电子和光伏应用材料至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种在具有共同晶体对称性的化合物的大型数据集中高通量计算 LTC 的方法。我们的方法将 MatterSim 1M 通用机器学习原子间势的微调与基于玻尔兹曼输运方程解的 LTC 计算相结合。我们引入了一种基于低秩自适应的基于对称性的小样本微调策略（SBFS-FT）。在这种方法中，MatterSim 1M 对一小部分精心挑选的具有共同晶体对称性的化合物进行微调。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate and efficient prediction of lattice thermal conductivity (LTC) is essential for developing materials for thermoelectric, microelectronic, and photovoltaic applications. Here, we present a methodology for high-throughput calculation of LTC across large datasets of compounds sharing a common crystal symmetry. Our approach combines fine-tuning of the MatterSim 1M universal machine-learned interatomic potential with LTC calculations based on the solution of the Boltzmann transport equation. We introduce a symmetry-based few-shot fine-tuning strategy (SBFS-FT) based on low-rank adaptation. In this approach, MatterSim 1M is fine-tuned on a small, carefully selected set of compounds that share a common crystal symmetry. The resulting potential is then applicable for accurate LTC calculations for compounds with this crystal symmetry, even if they were not included in the fine-tuning set. We tested our methodology on datasets of half-Heusler compounds (space group 216), materials with space group 225, and spinels (space group 227). We demonstrated that LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M fine-tuned using SBFS-FT exhibited a mean absolute relative difference from the reference results (obtained using moment tensor potentials and polyMLPs) 2-3 times smaller than that achieved with the non-fine-tuned MatterSim 1M potential. Moreover, the accuracy of LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M after SBFS-FT was comparable to that achieved using the MatterSim 1M potentials individually fine-tuned for each compound. Importantly, SBFS-FT enabled generation of the potential suitable for accurate LTC calculations across large compound datasets substantially faster than fine-tuning of MatterSim 1M for each compound individually, reducing the computational time by approximately a factor of 5-7 for a dataset of 100 compounds.

title: Introducing Vmol software: A highly parallelized multi-purpose DFT program based on real-space grid formalism
title_zh: Vmol 软件简介：基于实空间网格形式的高度并行化多用途 DFT 程序
summary: 我们对“Vmol”进行了回顾，这是一种基于真实空间网格形式的高度并行、多用途密度泛函理论 (DFT) 软件。通过利用高阶有限差分方法和非局部赝势，“Vmol”可作为 Kohn-Sham DFT 计算的通用且计算稳健的平台。凭借混合并行实现（消息传递接口/OpenMP），它可以在集成许多处理器的大规模并行计算机上提供高性能。
abstract: We present a review of “Vmol,” a highly parallelized, multi-purpose density functional theory (DFT) software based on a real-space grid formalism. By utilizing higher-order finite difference methods and nonlocal pseudopotentials, “Vmol” serves as a versatile and computationally robust platform for Kohn–Sham DFT calculations. By virtue of the hybrid parallel implementation (message passing interface/OpenMP), it delivers high performance on massively parallel computers integrating many processors. In the development of these several decades, “Vmol” offered marked adaptability as an electronic structure program to various extensions, such as the hybrid Quantum Mechanical (QM)/Molecular Mechanical (MM) approach and its combination with a theory of solutions (QM/MM-energy representation) based on statistical mechanics. We provide brief reviews of these methods as well as the important results obtained by their applications. “Vmol” was also utilized to implement kinetic energy and static correlation functionals formulated within the novel framework of DFT. The outline of the method will also be reviewed.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
title_zh: Orbitol：威科夫轨道上的晶体生成
summary: 生成模型通过学习成分和几何形状来提出晶体材料，但无条件采样无法直接控制空间群，这限制了压电等响应是否允许对称。我们推出了 Orbitol，一种基于 Crystalite 扩散变压器构建的晶体生成器，用威科夫轨道令牌取代了原子令牌。给定一个空间群和占据威科夫位置的集合，Orbitol 会生成每个轨道的原子类型和自由坐标以及兼容的晶格，因此每个有效结构在所请求的群的操作下都是不变的。在评估的设置下，它生成结构的速度比对称感知基线快两到三个数量级。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated settings. On MP-20, 13.8% of Orbitol's attempts yielded stable or metastable, unique and novel structures that retained the requested space group after relaxation, compared with 10.8% for SGFM, the next best model. We also introduce SPARC, a score that combines retention of the raw detected space group with agreement between the retained-group and training distributions. Finally, we used Orbitol to generate candidates in piezoelectric crystal classes. Of the structures selected by internal screening, 89% passed our density functional theory checks, and 79% also matched no Materials Project or Alexandria entry with the same space group. Their median figure of merit was nine times that of the piezoelectric materials computed in the Materials Project, and 24% of the new candidates ranked in that set's top 10%.

title: The effect of electrocatalyst roughness and morphology on selectivity due to mass transport
title_zh: 电催化剂粗糙度和形态对传质选择性的影响
summary: 当表面结合的反应中间体在电极和本体电解质之间交换时，质量传递可以显着影响电催化选择性。潜在的解吸-再吸附-反应机制允许中间体作为部分转化的产物逸出表面或重新吸附以继续转化，但目前尚不清楚催化剂形态如何影响这种竞争。在这里，我们重点关注电催化剂表面形态的作用及其在传输耦合动力学模型中的有效表示。
abstract: Mass transport can significantly affect electrocatalytic selectivity as surface-bound reaction intermediates are exchanged between the electrode and bulk electrolyte. The underlying desorption–re-adsorption–reaction mechanism allows an intermediate to escape the surface as a partially converted product or re-adsorb for continued conversion, but it is still not clear how the catalyst morphology affects this competition. Here, we focus on the role of the electrocatalyst surface morphology and its effective representation in transport-coupled kinetic models. Using CO selectivity during CO 2 reduction on copper as a model system, we compare predictions from a 1D diffusion model, where surface roughness serves as a single morphological descriptor, against a more advanced 3D diffusion model that explicitly resolves the full catalyst geometry. We analyze the results in terms of overlapping diffusion spheres between neighboring catalyst particles and find that the two models largely agree across the experimentally relevant parameter space due to a simple disparity in length scales. As diffusion occurs on a ∼μm scale, spatially resolved features of typical nm-sized catalyst particles are inconsequential. Surface roughness thus emerges as a surprisingly robust descriptor of electrocatalytic selectivity within the desorption–re-adsorption–reaction mechanism.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Electronic, structural and magnetic properties of goldene nanoribbons
title_zh: 金色纳米带的电子、结构和磁性特性
summary: 最近，二维金（一种单原子层金片）已通过实验实现，有望成为下一代器件的有前途的材料，提供超越三维块状金的新可能性。由于准一维导数可以表现出与其二维对应物明显不同的特性，因此我们使用第一原理计算方法研究了金基纳米带（GOLDNR）的稳定性、电子和磁性。我们的研究结果表明，这些纳米带的电子结构强烈依赖于边缘手性和带宽度。根据边界配置，系统可以表现出电子带隙约为 0.77 eV 和 0.04 eV 的半导体行为，或保留金属特性。
abstract: arXiv:2610.30010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two-dimensional goldene, a single-atomic-layer gold sheet, has been experimentally realized and is expected to be a promising material for next-generation devices, offering new possibilities beyond three-dimensional bulk gold. Because quasi-one-dimensional derivatives can exhibit properties markedly different from their two-dimensional counterparts, we investigate the stability, electronic, and magnetic properties of goldene-based nanoribbons (GOLDNRs) using first-principles computational methods. Our findings demonstrate that the electronic structure of these nanoribbons depends strongly on both edge chirality and ribbon width. Depending on the boundary configuration, the systems can exhibit semiconducting behavior with electronic band gaps of approximately 0.77 eV and 0.04 eV, or retain metallic characteristics. Additionally, the edge regions act as electronically active sites that may significantly enhance chemical reactivity relative to the central regions. As the ribbon width increases, the metallic characteristics of the infinite goldene sheet are progressively recovered, while the influence of quantum confinement and edge effects on the central region diminishes. These results provide important insights into tailoring the physical properties of goldene through lateral confinement, highlighting its potential for applications in nanoscale field-effect transistors, spintronic devices, and catalysis.

title: Ab Initio Approach for Quantum Magnets with Coupled Cluster and Transcorrelation
title_zh: 具有耦合簇和互相关的量子磁体从头算方法
summary: 最近邻交换耦合 J₁ 是用于理解实际材料中的磁性的哈密顿量模型的最简单成分。然而，它的从头确定需要高水平的相关处理和波函数展开的大量基础。在这里，我们使用嵌入式簇方法计算了五个氧桥自旋 1/2 量子磁体（Sr2CuO3、La2CuO4、NdNiO2、ZnCu3(OH)6Cl2 和 Li2CuO2）的 J₁，桥接角从 180^circ 到 94^circ，以及从反铁磁耦合到铁磁耦合的交叉。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nearest-neighbour exchange coupling J₁ is the simplest ingredient of model Hamiltonians used to understand magnetism in real materials. Nevertheless, its ab initio determination requires a high-level correlation treatment and a large basis for wave function expansion. Here we compute J₁ for five oxygen-bridged spin-1/2 quantum magnets --- Sr₂CuO₃, La₂CuO₄, NdNiO₂, ZnCu₃(OH)₆Cl₂, and Li₂CuO₂ --- spanning bridging angles from 180^circ to 94^circ and the crossover from antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic coupling, using embedded-cluster methodology. To describe the open-shell singlets we use 2-determinant coupled cluster with single and double excitations, which recovers the orbital-breathing enhancement of superexchange from a minimal reference. Basis-set errors are found to be large: extrapolation to the complete basis-set (CBS) limit shifts J₁ by up to 50 meV from bases of double-ζ quality. Transcorrelated Hamiltonians reproduce the CBS estimates with modest basis set sizes, yielding an excellent accuracy against experiment at highly affordable cost. These results are the first application of transcorrelated methods in strongly correlated solid-state systems, and establish transcorrelation as a powerful theory in computational research of materials.

title: Characterizing universal topological phases beyond spatial embedding
title_zh: 表征空间嵌入之外的通用拓扑相位
summary: 尽管汉密尔顿定律支配波-物质相互作用，但物质拓扑相位的传统表征需要的不仅仅是汉密尔顿定律，它依赖于在闭逆空间流形上定义的全局不变量或与位置算子的局部换向关系。这种空间依赖性排除了在抽象平台上对拓扑相位的独特表征，其哈密顿量可以独立于其空间嵌入进行定义。在这里，我们建立了一个表征通用拓扑相位的框架，其基础是任意汉密尔顿保留变形下拓扑特征的不变性。我们构造了一个基于汉密尔顿的空间嵌入，根据系统的连通性对系统的成分进行分组。
abstract: arXiv:2610.29022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although Hamiltonians govern wave-matter interactions, conventional characterizations of topological phases of matter require more than the Hamiltonian alone, relying on global invariants defined on closed reciprocal-space manifolds or local commutation relations with position operators. This spatial dependence precludes a unique characterization of topological phases on an abstract platform, whose Hamiltonian can be defined independently of its spatial embedding. Here we establish a framework for characterizing universal topological phases, grounded in the invariance of topological features under arbitrary Hamiltonian-preserving deformations. We construct a Hamiltonian-based spatial embedding that groups a system's constituents according to their connectivity. This embedding, which reproduces the results of conventional topological diagnostics in established systems, enables a coherent extension of topological phases to complex networks using the Hamiltonian alone, further highlighting exceptional robustness in small-world networks. Our results reshape the conceptual foundations of topological physics by decoupling topological characterization from prescribed physical platforms.
